decisions.title: Meta Muse Glimmer on Fireworks
decisions.reason_ja: Fireworks launch post for Meta Muse Glimmer. Genuine dual-enrichment gap: entities/muse-glimmer.md lacked architecture specs (52 layers, GQA 32/2 KV heads, ~1.8B perception encoder, sliding-window attention), full benchmark table vs Gemma 4 31B / Qwen 3.6 27B (DeepSearch QA 74.6, Gaia2 43.3, WildClawBench 47.6, SciCode 43.6, CharXiv 78.8), reasoning-effort control (Reasoning strength system prompt), and Fireworks serving details; entities/fireworks-ai.md had zero Muse coverage. decisions.body_excerpt: Muse Glimmer from Meta on Fireworks: Ideal for your Always-On Agents. 30B dense model, 52 transformer layers, GQA 32 query heads / 2 KV heads, SwiGLU, ~1.8B perception encoder, 128K+ context. Sliding-window attention over 2,048 tokens, global attention every 4th layer.
